title: EligibilityRequest
description: An eligibility request (the X12 270 equivalent, as JSON) for one coverage. Built at send time by the clearinghouse adapter from the eligibility check the outbox names (backend/app/modules/eligibility, build_request), sent to the simulated payer for the demo and, later, mapped to X12 270 by the real clearinghouse (Q11). Minimum necessary: no SSN (D27, D43), no address, no phone, no gender. Money and dates as strings (D40). x-phi marks each field's sensitivity as the API contract does (EXTENSIONS.md).

schemaVersion.description: This shape's version. A change that is not backward-compatible gets a new major version.

correlationId.description: Our eligibility check ID (X12 2000C TRN02 trace number). The reply echoes it, and the reply is filed against it, once.

createdAt.description: When the request was built (X12 BHT04/BHT05), UTC.

name.description: Payer name from our payer directory.

payerId.description: The payer's ID at this clearinghouse (admin.payer_clearinghouse_id). Absent when the practice has not mapped the payer for this clearinghouse; the simulated payer matches by name, a real clearinghouse refuses it.

provider.description: The provider asking (X12 2100B information receiver): the appointment's provider, otherwise the practice.

subscriber.description: The policy holder (X12 2100C). The patient, unless `dependent` is present.

memberId.description: The member ID the payer knows the subscriber by: the coverage's subscriber ID, or the patient's member ID.

groupNumber.description: Group number on the card, when there is one.

dependent.description: The patient, when the patient is not the subscriber (X12 2100D). Absent otherwise.

relationshipToSubscriber.description: FHIR subscriber-relationship code, as on the coverage (X12 INS02 is mapped by the clearinghouse).

memberId.description: The patient's own member ID, when the card shows one different from the subscriber's.

serviceDate.description: The date the coverage is asked about (X12 DTP*291): the appointment's day in the facility's time zone, otherwise the day the check was requested in the clinic's time zone.

serviceTypeCodes.description: X12 service type codes asked about (EQ01), `30` (health benefit plan coverage) by default.

Timestamp.description: An instant, RFC 3339, UTC with Z.

PersonName.description: A person's legal name (X12 NM103 family, NM104 first, NM105 middle names).
